novel_features.name: Movie night
novel_features.description: Resolve a film name, rank nearby showtimes, and optionally return the cinema booking handoff.
novel_features.rationale: It turns three MovieGlu calls and dynamic showtime formats into one deterministic agent workflow.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can answer the user’s actual movie-night question without manually joining IDs and showtime objects.

narrative.headline: Cross-chain movie showtimes and safe cinema booking handoffs from one agent-ready CLI.
narrative.value_prop: Resolve a film by name, rank nearby showtimes, and continue to the cinema website without manually joining film IDs, cinema IDs, dates, and dynamic format objects.
narrative.auth_narrative: Request MovieGlu evaluation credentials, then configure the API key, client username, authorization value, licensed territory, and optional geolocation.

quickstart.comment: Rank nearby evening showtimes for a film.
Return the cinema checkout handoff without launching it.

troubleshoots.symptom: The CLI reports a missing MovieGlu environment variable.
troubleshoots.fix: Run auth setup and configure every value MovieGlu supplied for the licensed territory.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to find films, cinemas, and showtimes across MovieGlu coverage and obtain a cinema website booking handoff.
anti_triggers: Do not claim the CLI selected seats or completed payment.
Do not launch the cinema website unless the user explicitly requested --launch.

recipes.title: Plan an evening movie
recipes.explanation: Resolves the film and ranks nearby evening screenings.

recipes.title: Continue to cinema checkout
recipes.explanation: Returns an HTTPS cinema booking URL but leaves seat selection and payment to the user.
